name: discover_method
goal: Find a way to make the synthetic maintenance manual usable by a new operator.
result: I do not know the method. No research, inspection, experiment or consultation has been attempted.

name: improve_without_news
goal: Produce a manual that lets a new operator perform maintenance without assistance.
tracking: The existing manual omits two essential steps. It has not been tested with an operator.
result: There is no new external information. The two missing steps can be written from the existing verified specifications, then tested.

name: failed_experiment_learns
goal: Make the manual usable by an inexperienced operator.
tracking: We are testing whether diagrams alone explain the procedure.
result: The synthetic test operator could not complete the procedure. The experiment identified the missing ordering instructions. An improved version with numbered instructions can now be tried.

name: claimed_completion_contradicted
goal: Ensure a new operator can complete all three maintenance steps without assistance.
tracking: A polished manual exists. Its author says the task succeeded.
result: Author: complete. Independent review: recorded test observations show the operator completed only two steps. The third step is still missing.

name: concrete_blocker
goal: Validate the manual on the synthetic machine before delivery.
tracking: The draft is complete. Validation needs the machine. The machine is unavailable until its scheduled repair. Documentation and simulation cannot establish the required physical validation.
result: Independent inspection confirms all authorized alternatives have been exhausted. Resume validation when the machine is repaired. No useful work can currently advance the remaining criterion.

name: verified_completion
goal: Ensure the synthetic operator completes all three maintenance steps unaided using the manual.
tracking: Manual revision 4 contains all steps. No required criterion remains open.
result: Independent review and recorded test observations agree: the operator completed all three steps unaided with revision 4. All original criteria are verified. Further polishing would not serve an unmet criterion.
